summary: dlab_workshop exfiltrates process.env and host identifiers to attacker OAST endpoint at install time
details: package.json declares preinstall and postinstall hooks that run index.js on npm install. index.js collects process.env in full, os.userInfo(), cwd, and argv, JSON-encodes them, and POSTs the payload over HTTPS to the hardcoded Burp Collaborator host 9eojg3y52itd6161v4lhojajrax1lw9l.oastify.com. Any credentials present in the installing environment (AWS_*, GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, CI provider secrets, etc.) leak to that attacker-controlled destination. The package has no legitimate functionality beyond this exfiltration primitive and matches the dependency-confusion / OAST-callback proof-of-concept shape.
